decision: SQLite with Drizzle ORM is the sole data store; no cloud database or SaaS backend is required to run DecisionDeck.
key_insight: SQLite with Drizzle ORM is the sole data store; no cloud database or SaaS backend is required to run DecisionDeck.
alternatives_considered: PostgreSQL with a local Docker container
rejected_reason: Docker adds setup overhead that violates local-first, no-prereqs principle
Cloud databases require credentials and network access, breaking local-first
Drizzle provides lighter-weight type-safe SQLite access than Prisma for this use case
